source_evidence: D327~10:21 exact player 'Yes that would be lovely' accepts Lady Halvessa's offered Sallow-mediated introduction to Noldren Tavosk after the corrected successful Deception25/DC17,22. No commitment to smuggling, investment, exclusive supply, hiring, payment, further deception or evidence disclosure. Halvessa voluntarily directs the already introduced household attendant to tell Sallow to arrange a private commercial introduction to Tavosk, and offers V a meeting with Sallow at the Veldrake townhouse at 15:00 today to discuss the introduction. This is a newly played ordinary household instruction and offered appointment with her own purchasing agent, not confirmed availability or attendance by Tavosk, actual delivery of message to Sallow, secret supper, transaction, or V commitment to the hour. Halvessa says 'Come back at three. I will have Sallow receive you here. He can arrange a proper introduction to Master Tavosk.' She remains cordial and views the party as prospective commercial contacts. V and companions still in reception, audience not automatically ended. No contested roll; prior successful concession covers acceptance. No new revelation, new attendee, expenditure, movement outside, or resource change. Watch has not yet learned Halvessa's firsthand statement. Await V's response or next action.
